Final required work adds feedback, clears rest and stays unsaved until Finish without moving the tapped row
Out-of-order completion retains the user viewport and the actual first unfinished exercise
Superset handoff changes the active exercise without a second scroll or data loss
Reopening and recompleting a set retains identities, values and anchored completion styling

Rapid repeated taps create one write, one completion and at most one moving highlight
A user scroll while IndexedDB completion is pending is retained; stale source coordinates cannot start a highlight
Focus coordinates timer-height change and exercise switching with the existing transform/easing and no page entrance replay
Reduced Motion uses instant state updates and numeric inputs remain touchable at320×548
